title: Kugura ibaro no kugendera
bridge: Mu gaciri, kugura ibaro tubwira tuti 'Hola' cyangwa 'Buenos días', kandi kugendera tubwira tuti 'Me llamo...' cyangwa 'Soy...'. Mu Icyongereza ni nkako: tubikora 'Hello' cyangwa 'Good morning' kandi tubwira tuti 'My name is...' cyangwa 'I am...'. Ububikozi bw’ingenzi ni uko mu Icyongereza ntidufata 'I am called...' (nako nubwo ni ukuri mu mibiri y’ijambo, birangwa bishya kandi bitabangikanya mu kwiganwa kw’umwanya). Nanone remera ko mu Icyongereza dusubira dusarura ishusho 'to be' mu kubaza izina: 'What is your name?' (nti 'How are you called?').
rule: Kugura ibaro: 'Hello' (Hola), 'Hi' (bishya kurushaho), 'Good morning' (Buenos días), 'Good afternoon' (Buenas tardes), 'Good evening' (Buenas noches mu kubakira). Kugendera: 'My name is...' (Me llamo...) cyangwa 'I am...' (Soy...). Kubaza izina: 'What is your name?' (¿Cómo te llamas?). Kugura ibaro: 'Nice to meet you' (Encantado/a de conocerte) kandi ububikozi ni 'Nice to meet you too'. Kugendera: 'Goodbye', 'Bye', 'See you later'.

common_error.explanation: Mu gaciri tubwira tuti 'Me llamo Anna', ariko mu Icyongereza ububikozi bw’ingenzi bwo kugendera ni 'My name is...' cyangwa 'I am...'. 'I am called' ni ukuri ariko birangwa bishya kandi bitabangikanya mu mibiri y’umwanya.

examples.note: Ububikozi bw’ingenzi bwo kuba izina ryawe.

title: Kugura ibyakozwe n'umwili (imiyoboro, ubutegetsi, ubucuruzi)
bridge: Mu gaciri, kugura imiyoboro tubwira tuti 'Nifite imiyoboro 25' (tugashimisha umubare 'gutera'), ariko mu gaciri tubwira tuti 'Ndi umwanya 25' (tugashimisha umubare 'kuba'). No kugura ubutegetsi tubwira tuti 'Ndi umunyarwanda' (bitagira akagari), ariko mu gaciri tubwira tuti 'Ndi umunyarwanda' (bitagira akagari). Kugura ubucuruzi, mu gaciri tubwira tuti 'Ndi umucozi' (bitagira akagari), ariko mu gaciri dukeneye akagari: 'Ndi umucozi'.
rule: Kugura imiyoboro: 'Ndi umwanya [umubare] y'imyaka' (erega: Ndi umwanya 25 y'imyaka). Kugura ubutegetsi: 'Ndi [ubutegetsi]' (erega: Ndi umunyarwanda, Ndi umukenka). Kugura ubucuruzi: 'Ndi umu/umu [ubucuruzi]' (erega: Ndi umudokotori, Ndi umuenzuzi). Kugura: 'Umyaka ingana?' (Umyaka ingana?), 'Wahatuye he?' (Wahatuye he?), 'Ukoza iki?' (Ukoza iki?) cyangwa 'Ubucuruzi bwawe ni igiki?'.

common_error.explanation: Mu gaciri tubwira tuti 'Nifite imiyoboro 25' tugashimisha umubare 'gutera', ariko mu gaciri tugashimisha umubare 'kuba' kugura imiyoboro. Ni cyo kibanza kirekire kurushaho abashikirwa n'ikinyarwanda.

title: Shyiraho ibintu n’abantu (mburasirazuba)
bridge: Mu gaciri, kugira ngo tushyireho ibintu n’abantu, dusiga amajyambo nyuma y’izina: ‘umukoko w’umweru’, ‘umukobwa uri hejuru’. Mu Icyongereza, amajyambo aga shinga kumpande wa mbere wa izina: ‘a red car’, ‘a tall girl’. Nanone, tushtuka amaso ku murongo ‘to be’ kuri ibyago by’ingenerwano (She is tall) n’ ‘have got’ kuri ibyago bya kimwuka (She has got blue eyes).
rule: Kugira ngo ushyireho: 1) Majyambo + izina (a big house). 2) Umushyiki + murongo ‘to be’ + majyambo (The house is big). 3) Umushyiki + ‘have/has got’ + ibyago (She has got long hair). Majyambo y’ingenerwano: big (kinini), small (sano), tall (hejuru), short (mbasi), beautiful (nziza), old (kirefu), young (gishyushye), fast (kiri mu bumbano), slow (ikimwuka).

common_error.explanation: Mu gaciri, amajyambo asiga nyuma y’izina (‘umukoko w’umweru’), ariko mu Icyongereza amajyambo asiga kumpande wa mbere wa izina (‘a red car’). Ni umwe mu bihamya bikomeye abashyirahamwe ba gaciri barakoze.

examples.note: Amajyambo asiga kumpande wa mbere wa izina.
Tushtuka amaso ku murongo ‘to be’ kuri ibyago by’ingenerwano.
Tushtuka amaso ku ‘have got’ kuri ibyago bya kimwuka.

examples.original: My brother is young and he has got green eyes.
examples.phonetic: /maɪ ˈbrʌðə ɪz jʌŋ ænd hiː hæz ɡɒt ɡriːn aɪz/
examples.translation: Umukuru wanjye yagishyushye kandi yarafashe amaso y’umutunzi.

title: Kujya mu rutogo rw'ibyo ubukorikira gukora
bridge: Mu igifaransa, kugira ngo dufate iby'ubukorikira gukora, tubona umwanya w'imbaraga: 'Nyamuka saa 7, nashyushye n'ubusa na ntekereza kuri murimo'. Mu icyongereza, tubona umwanya w'imbaraga ku mutwe ugufasha: 'I get up at 7, have breakfast and go to work'. Ikinyabwenge gikubiye ni uko mu icyongereza tubona amajwi yo kugena 'at' kuri saa ('at 7 o'clock'), 'in' kuri ibice by'umunsi ('in the morning') na 'on' kuri iminsi ('on Monday'). Nanone tubona amajwi yo kugena nk' 'always', 'usually', 'sometimes' mbere y'umubare w'ibintu.
rule: Kugira ngo dufate iby'ubukorikira gukora: 1) Bona umwanya w'imbaraga (I get up, she works). 2) Bona amajwi yo kugena: 'at' + saa (at 8 am), 'in' + ibice by'umunsi (in the morning), 'on' + umunsi (on Friday). 3) Bona amajwi yo kugena mbere y'umubare w'ibintu (I always eat breakfast). 4) Kugira ngo ubaze: 'What time do you get up?' cyangwa 'When do you have lunch?'.

concept_examples.text: She usually has breakfast at 8 am.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃiː ˈjuːʒuəli hæz ˈbrekfəst æt eɪt æm/

concept_examples.text: We go to work at 9 in the morning.
concept_examples.phonetic: /wiː ɡəʊ tə wɜːk æt naɪn ɪn ðə ˈmɔːnɪŋ/

concept_examples.text: What time do you have dinner?

common_error.wrong: I am eating breakfast every morning.
common_error.explanation: Mu igifaransa, hafi tubona umwanya w'imbaraga w'ibintu byinshi ('estoy desayunando cada mañana'), ariko mu icyongereza, kuri iby'ubukorikira gukora na iby'ubushakashatsi, tubona umwanya w'imbaraga, si w'ibintu byinshi.

examples.note: Umubare w'ibintu mu mwanya w'imbaraga kuri ubukorikira.

examples.phonetic: /aɪ hæv lʌntʃ æt wʌn piː em/

examples.original: What time do you go to bed?
examples.phonetic: /wɒt taɪm duː juː ɡəʊ tə bed/

title: Kumenya ibyoshyigiki no gutanga ibyoshyigiki (Nshaka / Sinashaka)
bridge: Mu gaciri, kugirango tusuzume ibyoshyigiki, tubikoraho umubare 'gustar': 'Me gusta la pizza' (mu kinyarwanda 'La pizza me gusta a mí'). Mu Icyongereza, tubikoraho umubare 'like' hamwe n'umubare w'ubwoko n'ikintu: 'I like pizza'. Ububabare buhagije ni uko mu gaciri umubare 'gustar' ubara inyuma y'ikintu (me gusta la pizza, me gustan las pizzas), kandi mu Icyongereza 'like' ubara inyuma y'umubare w'ubwoko (I like pizza, He likes pizza). Nanone remera ko kugirango tusuzume ibyoshyigiki tubwira 'I don't like' (no me gusta).
rule: Kugirango tusuzume ibyoshyigiki: 1) Kuri ijambo ry'ukuri: I/you/we/they like + ikintu (I like coffee). He/she/it likes + ikintu (She likes coffee). 2) Kuri ijambo ry'ububabare: I/you/we/they don't like (I don't like tea). He/she/it doesn't like (He doesn't like tea). 3) Kuri ibyibazo: Do you like...? (¿Te gusta...?), Does she like...? (¿Le gusta a ella...?). 4) Kugirango tusuzume neza: 'I like it very much' (Me gusta mucho) cyangwa 'I really like it' (Me gusta mucho).

common_error.explanation: Mu gaciri, ijambo 'mucho' rigaragara nyuma y'umubare: 'Me gusta mucho la pizza'. Mu Icyongereza, ijambo 'very much' rigaragara mu mwishywa w'ijambo cyangwa nyuma y'ikintu: 'I like pizza very much'. Kugiragarura hagati y'umubare n'ikintu ni ububabare buhagije.

examples.note: Tusanganywa na -s mu gitatu cya muntu.
Ibibazo n'ijambo ry'ubwoko 'do' + umubare w'ubwoko + umubare w'ubwoko wabasanywe.

title: Ask for and give prices
bridge: Mu gacanyi, kugirango tusabe neza ububiko, tubwira tuti 'How much is it?' (kuri kintu kimwe) canke 'How much are they?' (kuri ibintu byinshi). Kandi tubishyura tuti 'It is [nimero] dollars/euros' canke 'It costs [nimero].'
rule: Kugirango tusabe ububiko: 1) 'How much is it?' (kuri kintu kimwe) canke 'How much are they?' (kuri ibintu byinshi). 2) 'How much does it cost?' (Ubufaranga ni ukubona?). 3) 'How much is the T-shirt?' (Ubufaranga bwa shirt ni ukubona?). Kugirango tusubize: 'It is 25 dollars' canke 'It costs 25 dollars'. Mu byibazo, tubishyura tubishyura 'to be' canke 'does' + 'cost'.

common_error.explanation: Mu gacanyi, tubwira tuti 'Ubufaranga ni ukubona?' bifuzwa na mpamvu. Mu Icyongereza, kandi 'cost', dukeneye 'does' kugirango tusabe neza.

examples.original: How much does the bag cost?

examples.note: Tukoresha 'costs' mu ndimi ya muntu umwe.

title: Kugena aho uhuse ubwoko
bridge: Mu igifaransa, kugena aho uhuse ubwoko tubwira tuti 'It is on the street...', 'It is next to the bank', 'It is near the station'. Mu cyongereza, tubikora amajwi yo kugena aho nk'aho 'on', 'in', 'at', 'next to', 'near', 'opposite', 'behind', 'in front of'. Ubwishywa kuri abanyacyongereza ni uko mu igifaransa dukoresha 'en' ku byerekeye, kandi mu cyongereza, ijwi ry'urupapuro riravuzwa n'ibintu by'umwanya. Naho ushaka kumenya aho uhuse ubwoko, koresha ijwi 'to be' (It is...).
rule: Kugena aho uhuse ubwoko: 1) Koresha ijwi 'to be' (The bank is...). 2) Amajwi yo kugena aho: 'on' (ku, hejuru y'urupapuro), 'in' (in, munsi y'urupapuro), 'at' (at, aho hasi), 'next to' (hafi y'), 'near' (karita), 'opposite' (mu kure), 'behind' (in yuma), 'in front of' (mu kure). 3) Gusaba: 'Where is the...?' (Ubu ni aho?) cyangwa 'Is there a... near here?' (Hari aho... karita?).

concept_examples.text: The supermarket is near the park.
The school is next to the church.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə skuːl ɪz nekst tə ðə tʃɜːtʃ/

concept_examples.text: The pharmacy is on Main Street.

common_error.explanation: Mu igifaransa tubwira tuti 'It is on the corner' kandi kenshi dutanga umuntu. Mu cyongereza, umuntu 'It' cyangwa 'He/She' ni cyihariye. Nanone, 'en la esquina' tubwira tuti 'on the corner' (nti 'in the corner') ubwo aho ari mu kure y'amajwi.

examples.original: The cat is in the garden.
The restaurant is next to the hotel.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈrestrɒnt ɪz nekst tə ðə həʊˈtel/
examples.translation: Urugero rwa mazi uri hafi y'urugo.

examples.original: The bank is opposite the park.
examples.translation: Ubwoko bw'imishyashya uri mu kure y'urupfu.
